name: GD Discord Presence
description: Shows the level you're playing on your Discord profile, with GD Gaming List ranks.

enabled.name: Show on Discord
enabled.description: Show what you're doing in GD on your Discord profile. Needs the Discord app open on this PC.

client-id.name: Discord Application ID
client-id.description: The Application ID from discord.com/developers/applications. Leave empty to use the built-in one.

show-level-name.name: Show Level Names
show-level-name.description: Show the name and creator of the level. Turn off to just show "Playing a level".

show-progress.name: Show Progress
show-progress.description: Show your best % and attempt count.

show-gdgl.name: Show GDGL Rank
show-gdgl.description: When the level is on the GD Gaming List, show its rank (like GDGL #12).

check-updates.name: Check for Updates
check-updates.description: When GD starts, check for a new version of this mod and offer to install it.
